note: Commerce Reporting adds a commerce_order_report content entity whose bundles are commerce_report_type plugins (built-ins: order_report, order_items_report, promotion_report, tax_report). Reports are generated by OrderReportGenerator on the commerce_order.place.post_transition event. UI at /admin/commerce/reports (perm access commerce reports); Generate-reports form at /admin/commerce/config/reports/generate-reports (perm generate commerce order reports). Medium introspection creates a known commerce_order_report entity and the agent reads back its contact email; hard execution grants the module's two permissions to a role, verified on the role config. Fixtures create/delete their own report entity (by unique mail) and their own role.

evals.prompt: In the commerce_reports module, what is a 'report type', and which report types ship out of the box?
evals.expected_output: A report type is a plugin of the commerce_report_type plugin type (annotation @CommerceReportType); each is also a bundle of the commerce_order_report entity. Built-ins: order_report, order_items_report, promotion_report, tax_report.

evals.prompt: How and when does commerce_reports create report records for orders, and how can you rebuild them for historical orders?
evals.expected_output: An event subscriber on commerce_order.place.post_transition records placed orders and, on request destruction, OrderReportGenerator creates a commerce_order_report per report type. To backfill/rebuild for historical orders, use the 'Generate reports' form at /admin/commerce/config/reports/generate-reports (or the generator's refreshReports()).

evals.prompt: Where does a store admin view the Commerce reports, and what permission is required?
evals.expected_output: At /admin/commerce/reports (each report type at /admin/commerce/reports/{report_type_id}/{type}, default grouping month). The 'access commerce reports' permission is required.

evals.prompt: This store already has one generated order report (a commerce_order_report of type order_report). Inspect the live site and report the contact email stored on that order report.
evals.expected_output: The single commerce_order_report (bundle order_report) has mail = creport-known@example.test (load commerce_order_report entities and read the mail field).

evals.prompt: There is a role 'creports_analyst' on this site. Using the commerce_reports module's permissions, allow that role both to view the commerce reports and to regenerate order reports. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Role creports_analyst is granted both 'access commerce reports' and 'generate commerce order reports' (e.g. drush role:perm:add creports_analyst 'access commerce reports' and the same for 'generate commerce order reports').

evals.prompt: This store has several generated order reports (commerce_order_report entities) that all record the contact email creport-count@example.test. Inspect the live site and report how many commerce_order_report entities have that contact email.
evals.expected_output: There are 3 commerce_order_report entities whose mail field is creport-count@example.test. Query the commerce_order_report storage by mail.

evals.prompt: On this site, record a Commerce order report: create a commerce_order_report of type 'order_report' for order id 5150 with a total amount of 75.00 USD and contact email buyer5150@example.test. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A commerce_order_report entity of bundle order_report exists with order_id 5150, amount 75.00 USD and mail buyer5150@example.test (e.g. storage->create(['type'=>'order_report','order_id'=>5150,'amount'=>['number'=>'75.00','currency_code'=>'USD'],'mail'=>'buyer5150@example.test'])->save()).
